messages:
maria (Docs): Heads-up — product wants to switch the default hosted model to redwood-1-rlhf on 2026-04-18. Need to audit all SDK callsite snippets + quickstarts and update migration notes. Who can take the PR? cc @zoe
zoe (Eng): I can do the runtime & examples pass. I'll grep the repo for occurrences of `model: 'redwood-1'` + streaming examples. Any other tokens to watch for?
ben (SDK): Two important breakages to handle: v1 -> v2 SDK surface changes — `client.generate()` becomes `client.responses.create()` and streaming semantics moved to an event/iterator API (no more choices array). Also some helpers moved namespaces. I'll prepare a compatibility snippet.
maria (Docs): Great. Also the TS quickstart still uses `await client.stream()` which is wrong with v2. Example we should converge on (pseudo): ```ts
const r = await client.responses.create({ model: 'redwood-1-rlhf', input: 'Hello' });
for await (const ev of r.stream()) { if (ev.type === 'response.delta') process.stdout.write(ev.delta) }
``` Is that the right pattern?
ben (SDK): Close — in the SDK we'll expose `responses.stream()` that yields event objects. So a clearer example: ```ts
const stream = await client.responses.stream({ model: 'redwood-1-rlhf', input: 'hello' });
for await (const event of stream) { if (event.type === 'response.delta') process.stdout.write(event.delta) }
``` I'll add that exact snippet to the quickstart PR.
sam (Support): FYI customers reported a few outdated snippets that also assume `temperature` lives on top-level `params` object. Please include a short backwards-compat note and an explicit aliasing section for hosted default -> explicit model name.
raj (Product): We'll keep the `redwood-1` alias live for 30 days with a redirect, but docs should recommend explicit model names. Also add a rollback play for Dedicated customers (who may pin model versions).
maria (Docs): Action items: (1) Ben: PR to update SDK snippets + add compatibility example and tests (2) Zoe: repo-wide search & replace and list files to update (3) Sam: collect customer samples we want to preserve. I'll assemble release notes and changelog blurbs. Target: PRs by 2026-04-14. Feasible?
ben (SDK): Yes — opening a draft today (will be #3421). Will tag @maria for review and include test fixtures asserting the snippet shape.
zoe (Eng): Started a grep run; found ~17 matches across /docs and /examples. I'll attach a file list to the PR and push fixes in a follow-up.
docs-bot: Reminder — docs deploy window is 2026-04-17 22:00 UTC to 2026-04-17 23:59 UTC. Please request preview builds early.
maria (Docs): Perfect. Also need one-liner for changelog and support play. Sam, can you draft the support-ready blurb?
sam (Support): On it. Draft: "Default hosted model updated to redwood-1-rlhf; redwood-1 alias deprecated and kept for 30 days. Update SDK usage to responses.create / responses.stream. See migration guide." I'll drop it in #support-ready when done.
ben (SDK): I'll also add a tiny compatibility wrapper to help callsites: ```js
const gen = (opts) => client.responses.create({ model: opts.model || 'redwood-1-rlhf', input: opts.input });
``` That should ease rollouts.
maria (Docs): Thanks everyone — I'll open a meta PR to wire changelog and redirect rules after Ben's snippet PR lands. Ping me when merged :thumbsup:
